dr_severity_od.instructions: Grade the diabetic retinopathy in the right eye on the International Clinical Diabetic Retinopathy severity scale.
criteria: Moderate NPDR: more than just microaneurysms but less than severe NPDR

Severe NPDR: any of >20 intraretinal haemorrhages in each of 4 quadrants, definite venous beading in 2 or more quadrants, or prominent IRMA in 1 or more quadrants, and no signs of proliferative retinopathy
PDR: neovascularisation and/or vitreous or preretinal haemorrhage

dr_severity_os.instructions: Grade the diabetic retinopathy in the left eye on the International Clinical Diabetic Retinopathy severity scale.
criteria: Moderate NPDR: more than just microaneurysms but less than severe NPDR

Severe NPDR: any of >20 intraretinal haemorrhages in each of 4 quadrants, definite venous beading in 2 or more quadrants, or prominent IRMA in 1 or more quadrants, and no signs of proliferative retinopathy
PDR: neovascularisation and/or vitreous or preretinal haemorrhage

dme_center_involving_od.instructions: Is there centre-involving diabetic macular oedema in the right eye (thickening or fluid within the central 1 mm subfield)?

criteria.true: Macular oedema involves the central subfield
criteria.false: No macular oedema, or oedema sparing the central subfield
